summary: Frozen P1 debug design builds a Routed bit (exit 0, 637 s) but G2 fails (SWNS -4.293 / STNS -488.545 / HWNS -3.456 ns; 882 setup + 400 hold failing endpoints) because the debug wrapper adds a u_top level and the production SDC clock definitions no longer match.
